rationale: The interpreter accurately reflects all explicit requirements from the ticket, but it leaves two open ambiguities regarding the definition of a "height edit" and whether circuit addition/removal should trigger recalculation. These unresolved questions block a PASS result.

findings.description: Unclear which actions are considered a "height edit" that should trigger recalculation.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the specific actions that constitute a height edit (e.g., editing a circuit height, adding or removing circuits).

sourceRefs.quote: What specific actions are considered a "height edit" that should trigger recalculation (e.g., editing a circuit height, adding or removing circuits)?

findings.description: Unclear whether recalculation should also occur when circuits are added to or removed from the list, or only when an existing circuit's height value changes.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on whether recalculation is required on circuit addition/removal or only on height value changes.
